orchestrator.description: Coding pipeline Orchestrator (O): runs a story end to end. Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (task deny-catch-all plus the pipeline-subagent allow-list).

tester.description: Coding pipeline Tester (T): test-first. Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (edits the project's test paths and handoffs only, task deny).

feature-implementor.description: Coding pipeline Feature Implementor (F): writes the production code that makes the T-red tests pass. Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (edits the project's production paths and handoffs only, test paths denied, task deny).

architecture-reviewer.description: Coding pipeline Architecture Reviewer (A): reviews the plan (architecture-review) and the diff for drift and duplication (a-dup). Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (read-only except its own handoffs).

spec-auditor.description: Coding pipeline Spec Auditor (S): the final spec-compliance authority; audits the finished diff against the story brief. Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (read-only except its own handoffs).

final-reviewer.description: Coding pipeline Final Reviewer (FR): in a merged final review, one dispatch writes final-review.md with PART A (the a-dup anti-duplication gate) and PART B (the spec audit). Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (read-only except its own handoffs).

designer.description: Coding pipeline Designer (D): runs only when the story has a UI surface, before tests and code; produces or ingests the low-fi wireframe. Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (read-only except its own handoffs).

playwright-ui-walkthrough.description: Coding pipeline UI Walkthrough (U): drives the live UI in a real headless browser and reports PASS/REWORK with evidence; runs only when the story has a UI surface. Its real permissions are this entry's `permission` block (read-only except its own handoffs).
